description: Entry 9's cal-anchored wall, quantified from the other side. The corpus bounds IDENTIFYING c_3 from data (6.99-digit deficit); this bounds what a DERIVED c_3 would buy. An exact c_3 leaves |c_4|*u^4, so the L2 target is met iff |c_4| <= 1.4816073. Cuts both ways: one derived rung closes the whole gap, BUT |c_2|=1 and |c_3|=2.069342577, and continuing that growth puts |c_4|~4.28218, missing by ~2.89x. Also shows the cached c_3 IS the greedy annihilating value and the cached c_4=0 is a greedy artifact carrying no evidence. THRESHOLD IS CONVENTION-INDEPENDENT (u has no Markov parameter) but assumes the re-derived D ladder keeps the same u-graded product form; the 'one rung closes it' reading is C-frame, resting on the C-cache k=2 residual. The c_k^even exact rungs do NOT sharpen the |c_4| question: the c_k are not scalar-q Taylor coefficients (u is quadratic in q-1, so the u-reversion is singular) and the extraction amplifies input error by sigma_R/u^k, measured at ~7e5 for k=2 -- a 15-digit 'exact' match there was noise.

data.scope: Scope (a). No c_k proposed, extracted, fitted or wired. No D-frame Q_beta computed — the producer's convention-D refusal stands untouched. The conclusion is CONDITIONAL on |c_4|, which is underived; the cached 0.0 is a greedy artifact and is not evidence.
